start-application.name: Start an Application
start-application.description:
Your journey to becoming a Member at The American Club starts here.

Get to know the requirements to start your application.

All the items outlined in the Application Checklist must be submitted. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

joining-fees.name: Membership Types & Joining Fees
joining-fees.description: Five distinct membership types designed for different eligibility criteria. All fees are inclusive of prevailing GST.

referal.name: Refer a Friend
referal.description: Introduce a friend to become a Member of The American Club and get rewarded with Club dining vouchers.

niche-group-membership.name: Niche Group Membership
niche-group-membership.description: The American Club Niche Group Membership rewards Members for their membership tenure or spending. VIP Gold, 10K, 15K & Elite are the four tiers.

tierCards.heading: The Niche Group Membership Tiers
tierCards.subheading: From your first tier to the highest level, each level brings added benefits created to enrich your time at your Club.

cards.name: Elite Membership
cards.description: A minimum of $20,000 cumulative calendar year spending, excluding monthly dues.
benefits: Welcome dining voucher worth $250 and $150 sên Spa voucher.
Annual welcome gift.
Wedding Anniversary Privilege.
Exclusive privileges during birthday month
Annual Elite party invites.
Up to 25% dining discounts.
Up to 20% off treatments at sên Spa.
Membership card replacement fee waiver ($10 for the first card replacement, $50 for subsequent replacements).
Ad-hoc discounts for products, events etc.
Free parking for two cars (fee waiver will be applied at the next annual billing cycle in July).

cards.name: VIP Gold
cards.description: Members are accorded this status based on a minimum tenure of 25 years of active membership.
benefits: A welcome dining voucher worth $200.
Exclusive privileges during birthday month
Annual VIP party invites.
Up to 20% dining discounts.
Up to 20% off treatments at sên Spa.
Ad-hoc discounts for products, events etc.

cards.name: 15K Membership
cards.description: A minimum of $20,000 cumulative calendar year spending, excluding monthly dues.
benefits: A welcome dining voucher worth $200.
Exclusive privileges during birthday month
Up to 20% dining discounts.
Up to 15% off treatments at sên Spa.
Membership card replacement fee waiver ($10 for the first card replacement, $50 for subsequent replacements).
Ad-hoc discounts for products, events etc.
Free parking for one car (fee waiver will be applied at the next annual billing cycle in July).

cards.name: 10K Membership
cards.description: A minimum of $10,000 cumulative calendar year spending, excluding monthly dues.
benefits: Exclusive privileges during birthday month
Up to 15% dining discounts.

Ad-hoc discounts for products, events etc.

reciprocal-clubs.name: Reciprocal Clubs
reciprocal-clubs.description: As a Member of The American Club, enjoy privileged access to over 150 distinguished clubs worldwide, extending the comfort of membership wherever you travel.

advertise-with-us.name: Advertise with Us
advertise-with-us.description:
Reach a community of over 11,000 engaged Members at The American Club.

With a suite of targeted communication channels, we provide advertising opportunities that connect your message with our Member community in a thoughtful and purposeful way.

extraSections.title: Sponsorship
extraSections.content:
Access a Premium Network of Affluent, International Members

Our sponsors and strategic partners gain prominent brand exposure and meaningful engagement opportunities within our Club community. Reach out to schedule a discussion on the best channels to showcase your brand.
